Command.Name: ReadDiagnostics
Command.FPOperation: Provides information about documents sending functions .

Res.Name: OptionDeviceType
Res.Desc: 1 symbol for device type: - '1' - A Type - '2' - B Type

Res.Name: SDIdxPos
Res.Desc: 10 symbols for current SD index position of last sent receipt

Res.Name: LastInvoiceCUNum
Res.Desc: 19 symbols for number of last invoice according the CU

Res.Name: LastInvoiceDate
Res.Desc: 6 symbols for last invoice date in the DDMMYY format

Res.Name: LastEODDate
Res.Desc: 6 symbols for last sent EOD in the DDMMYY format

Res.Name: InvoicesSent
Res.Desc: 4 symbold for number of invoices sent for the current day
